purpose: Teach: 議長/座長/委任/定額/賃貸/図面/法制/県知事

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 役員会の、本気で、絶対、議長、絶対、選出、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward decisively with selecting a board chairperson.
lines.style: Brisk, businesslike tempo. Clean attack on the opening syllable. Forward momentum throughout—no hesitation. Voice sits at professional register, lean and efficient.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。シンポジウムの、本気で、絶対、座長、絶対、依頼、絶対、進めております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're proceeding with the symposium chair selection request. I appreciate your confidence.
lines.style: Engaged and cooperative. Slight vocal lift on the affirmative. Measured pace that matches Yuki's tempo. Professional but warm—acknowledging the collaboration.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 代理人への、本気で、絶対、委任、絶対、状、絶対、ご準備、絶対、お願いします
lines.en: Please prepare the proxy delegation documents for us.
lines.style: Clear directive. Polite request wrapped in quiet authority. Slight elongation on the key phrase—'proxy delegation'—to ensure clarity. Direct eye-contact energy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サブスクの、本気で、絶対、定額、絶対、プラン、絶対、人気です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The subscription flat-rate plan is performing well. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Positive update delivered with calm assurance. Slight lift in tone on 'performing well'—genuine appreciation, not performative. Steady pace, conversational warmth.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィスの、本気で、絶対、賃貸、絶対、料、絶対、交渉、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with negotiating the office lease terms.
lines.style: Clear and purposeful. Same brisk energy as the opening line. Controlled, no unnecessary breath. Forward-focused delivery that invites alignment without demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。設計士から、本気で、絶対、図面、絶対、受け取りました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've received the blueprints from the architect. Thank you for handling that.
lines.style: Confirmation delivered with quiet competence. Slight emphasis on 'received'—task complete. Warm acknowledgment of work done. Professional, unhurried.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、法制、絶対、対応、絶対、勉強会、絶対、企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's organize a training session on industry regulations and compliance.
lines.style: Forward-moving directive with clarity. Slightly faster tempo on 'training session'—showing initiative. Engaged but not urgent. Professional suggestion framed as collaborative next step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。県知事、本気で、絶対、表敬訪問、絶対、ご日程、絶対、調整しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the schedule for the courtesy visit with the governor. Thank you for coordinating.
lines.style: Closing statement delivered with composed satisfaction. Slight finality on 'confirmed'—important task secured. Warm acknowledgment of effort. Professional, reassuring tone.
